about.title: An analytical thinker who likes building things that work.
paragraphs: I'm a B.Tech student in Computer Science Engineering, specializing in Data Science & Big Data Analytics at KLEF Deemed to be University. I enjoy the full journey of data — from messy raw extracts to the dashboard a decision-maker actually opens.

As a Data Analyst Intern at Apollo Pharmacy, I analyzed pharmacy sales and operational data, built Power BI dashboards for KPI tracking, and worked on cleaning, validation and ETL workflows with SQL, Python and Databricks.

I'm especially drawn to building reliable data pipelines and business intelligence solutions, and to applying machine learning for predictive analytics. Alongside data work I keep sharpening my software engineering fundamentals in Java and data structures.
I learn by building — every project here started as a question I wanted to answer properly, with reproducible code and honest numbers.

projects.title: Pipelines, models and dashboards — end to end.
projects.description: Three projects that span data engineering, machine learning and business intelligence. Open any card for the full breakdown.
projects.thumbnailNote: Thumbnail is an illustrative rendering of the project's outputs, not a screenshot of its results.

apollo-goa.summary: Retail analytics platform built on a SQL medallion architecture and Databricks Delta Lake, processing 7.17M+ transaction records with store-level Prophet forecasting and ABC/XYZ + K-Means segmentation.
overview: Developed a retail analytics platform using a SQL medallion architecture and Databricks Delta Lake to process more than 7.17 million transaction records.

Raw POS extracts were consolidated in SQL Server, re-modelled through bronze/silver/gold layers, mirrored into Databricks as Delta tables, and surfaced through a Power BI report and a standalone web dashboard.
Implemented Prophet-based store-level sales forecasting and customer/product segmentation using ABC/XYZ analysis and K-Means clustering.
features: SQL Server bronze → silver → gold medallion views over one consolidated sales table
Databricks Delta Lake layers with business-question SQL notebooks
Prophet forecasting for per-store next-month sales
Store-SKU segmentation with ABC/XYZ analysis and K-Means
Power BI dashboard with 30+ visuals plus a web dashboard with data lineage docs

zomato-bi.summary: End-to-end analytics pipeline with ML models for delivery-time prediction and customer churn classification, plus a six-page Power BI dashboard backed by automated tests.
overview: Built an end-to-end analytics pipeline incorporating machine learning models for delivery-time prediction and customer churn classification.

Twelve raw operational tables move through cleaning, SQL analytics, exploratory analysis and feature engineering into two independent ML problems and Power BI-ready datasets — each stage reproducible with its own script.
Developed a six-page Power BI dashboard with automated testing and reproducible analytical workflows.
features: Delivery-time regression from distance, traffic, weather and prep-time features
Customer churn classification over a 60-day inactivity window
SQL analytics on PostgreSQL and SQLite
Six-page Power BI dashboard and written business-insights report
Automated test suite and one-script-per-stage reproducible pipeline
zomato-bi.note: Built on a synthetic, Zomato-style dataset for learning purposes — not real Zomato data.

sql-warehouse.summary: SQL Server data warehouse integrating CRM and ERP sources through Bronze, Silver and Gold layers into an analytics-ready star schema.
overview: Designed a SQL Server data warehouse integrating CRM and ERP data through a Bronze, Silver, and Gold medallion architecture.
Implemented ETL workflows with stored procedures for ingestion, data cleansing, standardization and multi-source integration.
Modelled the Gold layer as a star schema so business users can query clean dimensions and facts directly.
features: Bronze / Silver / Gold layered warehouse in SQL Server
Stored-procedure ETL for ingestion, cleansing and standardization
Star schema dimensional model for analytics
Data quality checks and documented naming conventions

supply-chain.summary: Synthetic ERP supply-chain data modelled with dbt on DuckDB, Prophet demand forecasts tracked in MLflow, OR-Tools reorder-point optimization and a Streamlit dashboard, orchestrated by Airflow on Docker with GitHub Actions CI.

twitter.summary: Hackathon project classifying tweets as positive or negative: text preprocessing and stemming, TF-IDF features and Logistic Regression trained on the 1.6M-tweet Sentiment140 dataset (77.6% test accuracy).

agv.summary: Differential-drive mobile robot simulation with ROS 2 Jazzy, Gazebo Harmonic and Nav2 — LiDAR and camera sensors, SLAM mapping, AMCL localization and autonomous navigation with an MPPI controller.
